recentItems.title: Meet the Team Tasked with Maintaining the 9/11 Reflecting Pools
recentItems.description:
"It's more than a job because I'm doing it for the 3,000 that lost their lives and everybody around the world that sees this and sees that this is not a disaster anymore. It's a future, and it's a bright future."

Overnight, five nights a week, Jim Maroon and his team of custodians clean the 9/11 memorial reflecting pools, and they gave TODAY's Craig Melvin a behind-the-scenes look at their noble work.

This piece originally aired September 11, 2025.

recentItems.title: Xolo Maridueña Talks ‘Practical Magic 2,’ ‘Blue Beetle,’ More
recentItems.description:
Xolo Maridueña stops by TODAY to talk about his role in the highly anticipated film “Practical Magic 2.” He reveals his family’s reaction to his intimate scenes in the movie and talks about his song being featured in the film. “It was such a gift to be able to share that with the people that made the song with me,” he says. He also talks about his upcoming return to “Blue Beetle” in the DC Universe. “The suit still fits,” he jokes.

recentItems.title: Domhnall Gleeson on ‘The Paper’ S2, Taylor Swift’s ‘Opalite’ Video
recentItems.description:

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Olivia Walton Pledges $100 Million to Reduce Maternal Death Rate
recentItems.description:
According to the CDC, 87% of pregnancy-related deaths are preventable, so Olivia Walton, founder of Healthy Moms Healthy Babies America, and the organization's president Dr. Neel Shah, join TODAY to share that Walton and her husband are pledging $100 million to achieve their goal of cutting the U.S. maternal death rate in half. "Investing in maternal health care is the single most strategic thing we can do for the future of American prosperity," Walton says.
